parsed.explanation: Claim 3.2 applies π(·) to an arbitrary minimal transversal T of C, but nothing in the text shows minimal transversals of C are finite; Zorn (Step 4(a)) only yields minimality, not finiteness. The objection's example {{x,t_n}: n≥1} is a pairwise-intersecting antichain of finite sets with the infinite minimal transversal {t_n}, so finiteness does not follow from (i)+(ii). Hence hypothesis (iii) of the core theorem is verified only for finite minimal transversals, while Step 4 invokes (iii) on T extracted from the infinite set I∪Z_ω. No other passage supplies finiteness of minimal transversals, so the finiteness of M (L6.2) is not established; a new lemma is needed.
